name: svg-path
title: Marquee on SVG Path
description: Animate any content along a custom SVG path. Supports scroll velocity, drag interaction, hover slowdown, and responsive scaling.

changelog.summary: Ported prefers-reduced-motion support from the docs copy: static scroll-tracked positioning instead of spring/lerp smoothing, and dragging disabled while reduced motion is active.
Marquee now suspends its per-frame work while offscreen or in a hidden tab via the shared createSuspendedRaf visibility gate
